findings.summary: Dev-note input_commit invariant still violated (spec §5 footnote; same class as prior REJECT findings). The note records input_commit `08e8d2d3a2461d032d18848b34436d1ea072a23c` (the note's own body-only commit H_body), but the actual final delivery commit — the very commit this note inhabits, verified by the deterministic seal against Git HEAD — is `ecbadcada4b1bafd2156a25a7a3107bc79367804`. Spec §5 footnote is explicit: "input_commit 必须等于最终交付 commit；中途 rework 则 note 必须同步更新". The implementer's two-step workaround (lines 19-24) records the parent H_body rather than the final delivery commit that carries the note with the updated field. This is the same invariant class that attempt 1 (finding 2) and attempt 2 rejected for recording a non-delivery commit. All product code (R1–R6), the mutation matrix (R8 attribution), non-goals (§4), and the dev-note path fix (prior attempt-1 finding 1) are correct and complete; only this evidence invariant remains.
